description: SDXL-style UNet denoising benchmark using diffusers UNet2DConditionModel with DDPM scheduler. Larger model than Stable Diffusion with 4-level UNet and higher-resolution latents (128x128). Reports steps/sec throughput.

non_scaling_params.name: batch
non_scaling_params.description: Number of images to generate in parallel

non_scaling_params.name: sample_size
non_scaling_params.description: Spatial resolution of the latent (latent height/width)

non_scaling_params.name: layers_per_block
non_scaling_params.description: Number of ResNet layers per UNet block

non_scaling_params.name: cross_attention_dim
non_scaling_params.description: Dimension of the cross-attention conditioning (text encoder hidden size)
